info.about: Thunderpick World Championship 2026 (Malta, HLTV event 8932) day 1 = 14 Oct 2026. Results and maps from HLTV; unsupported player ratings omitted; pre-match prices from the Pinnacle guest API reads archived in this repository (session 8944bb84, read 2026-10-14 01:48 UTC); Hotspawn crowd pick shares from the pre-lock board capture (session 8e782f95, board/data/analysis.csv). Derived numbers (de-vig, own line, strategy class) are recomputed by hotspawn/model.py with today's rule so the review shows what the rule would have said. Compiled by arena/22be6967 on 2026-10-15 10:10-10:30 UTC.

event.format: Group matches are BO3 LAN (confirmed by the linked match pages). No unverified playoff series length is asserted here.

flag_text.KICKOFF_GAP: Outside source lists a different kickoff than Hotspawn (joined because both teams match and the gap is within 6 h).
flag_text.ALIAS: A team name was joined through a verified alias (see research/aliases.json for the evidence).
flag_text.NO_MARKET: No eligible outside price captured; the probability is our own line from official Valve points.
flag_text.MODEL_MARKET_SPLIT: Our own line and the market disagree on the favourite or by 10+ points.
flag_text.BOOK_PM_SPLIT: Pinnacle and Polymarket differ by 8+ points.
flag_text.ROSTER_UNVERIFIED: A match-specific roster report does not verify this fixture’s current lineup; own probabilities withheld and factual lineup left blank.
flag_text.VRS_ROSTER_OUTDATED: A source-checked lineup differs from the five rated in Valve's snapshot; the dated rating does not establish the actual current lineup.
flag_text.FORMAT_UNKNOWN: No source stated the series length; nothing was assumed.
flag_text.UNRESOLVED: No eligible outside line or independent direction satisfies the evidence gates; pick and probabilities are left blank.
flag_text.RESEARCH_FALLBACK: No outside price and no strict own line; the pick is our own line on a Valve standings row disambiguated by documented roster overlap with HLTV's listed match lineup (research rung E). Softer than a market price.
flag_text.VALVE_NAME_AMBIGUOUS: The team name maps to more than one roster row in Valve's standings, or the Valve row is filed under a different team name; the row used was chosen by the documented roster-overlap rule and is linked on the row.
flag_text.POST_LOCK_RESOLUTION: The fixture appeared minutes before its pick lock and research finished after it. The pick is retrospective analysis only, is excluded from the graded pick history, and was never a submittable pick'em pick.
flag_text.STALE_LISTING: Hotspawn still lists this fixture although its lock time passed more than 36 h ago (not pickable).
flag_text.LOCKED: Lock time has passed; kept for the record and for grading.
flag_text.CROWD_MISSING: Hotspawn did not publish a crowd share; no leaderboard play computed.
flag_text.HOTSPAWN_PARTIAL: At least one Hotspawn surface is empty, unavailable or inconsistent in this capture; full live coverage is not certified.
flag_text.COIN_FLIP: Probabilities within one point of 50%; no meaningful directional edge. Only an exact tie may use the eligible own line as a tiebreaker.
flag_text.STALE_PRICE: An outside quote is missing a usable read time or is older than 8 h; rejected, not used.
flag_text.REJECTED_QUOTE: A same-pair quote was rejected (competition, rematch ambiguity, freshness, format, or validity); see the row's evidence.
flag_text.BOOKMAKER_UNVERIFIED: Two-sided match quote observed in bo3.gg, but the operator is identified only by an internal ID. Bookmaker name is blank, not inferred from an affiliate URL; no automatic contrarian fade.
flag_text.RELAYED_BOOK: A sportsbook line relayed by bo3.gg (operator name or internal ID retained); not verified directly with the bookmaker. Secondary evidence only.
flag_text.VRS_STALE: Valve's rating snapshot has no usable date, is future-dated, or is more than 45 days old; an own-line probability is withheld.
flag_text.OWN_LINE_WITHHELD: An own line is not supported for this fixture's known roster/format/rating freshness; blank rather than invented.
flag_text.IDENTITY_CONFLICT: Hotspawn surfaces disagree on fixture identity or timing; no probability is published for this ID.
flag_text.NO_DIRECTION: The eligible outside price is exactly 50/50 and no eligible independent line breaks the tie; no side invented.
flag_text.MODEL_ONLY: Own originated estimate, not an observed bookmaker line; format-specific calibration and map veto are not modelled.
flag_text.DIRECTION_ONLY: Research rung F: a pick direction is published from HLTV's own one-sided verdict (ranking, recent form, head-to-head) because no price and no rating pair exist. No win probability is published for this match.
flag_text.NO_PERCENTAGE: No eligible outside price and no rating pair for both teams, so the percentage columns are blank rather than invented.
flag_text.EGW_PLACEHOLDER: EGamersWorld displays its 1.8 / 1.8 placeholder price on this match. A placeholder is not a market price and was rejected.

twc_days.purpose: Thunderpick World Championship 2026 (HLTV event 8932) days 1-3 review, the Aurora roster change, and a day-4 (17 Oct 2026) semifinal watch. Read-only: this file never creates, edits or grades a Hotspawn pick.

event.name: Thunderpick World Championship 2026
event.format_note: Two GSL groups of four, all group matches BO3; top two per group to a single-elimination BO3 playoff; third-place decider and BO5 grand final on 18 Oct.
event.playoff_note: HLTV's own playoff bracket at this read shows the semi-finals as Falcons vs BETBOOM and FURIA vs Aurora.

hotspawn_listing_status.detail: The live Hotspawn lobby tournament filter at this read lists 83 CS2 fixtures and its only Thunderpick World Championship 2026 entries are the stale 'Thunderpick World Championship 2026: South American Series #1' qualifiers (8 fixtures, June 2026). The Malta main-event day-4 semifinals are NOT on the Hotspawn board in this capture, so they are a watch item, not a pickable pick'em row.

days.upset_note: 9z beat Aurora 2-0 on day 1. HLTV's report describes it as a statement win against the fifth-ranked team in the VRS and credits luchov with a 1.61 rating. It is one result, not a permanent head-to-head edge: the day-3 rematch reversed it.

aurora_roster_change.summary: Aurora rebuilt from an all-Turkish roster into an international one across six days in July 2026 - three players and the head coach changed. The new five debuted at BLAST Bounty 2026 Season 2 (21 July 2026), roughly three months before this event.

timeline.event: MAJ3R steps down from the active roster; soulfly is benched
Aurora sign Jimpphat (from MOUZ) and name ash (ex-GamerLegion) head coach
Aurora acquire kyxsan from Falcons as the new in-game leader, completing the rebuild

aurora_roster_change.onboarding_caution: The rebuild is dated, not fresh: the five had been together since 8 July 2026 and had already reached a top-four at this event before the day-4 semifinal. Nothing in this file converts the roster change into a numeric adjustment, and no rest or fatigue percentage is asserted.

day4.note: Not listed on the Hotspawn board at this read (see hotspawn_listing_status). Lines below are outside prices for guidance only; they are not Hotspawn picks and cannot be submitted.

market.caveat: A true 50/50 price: the market is not separating these teams. Treated as a coin flip, not an edge.

Two-way moneyline with the margin removed. bo3.gg's own page also lists Falcons to win at least one map at 1.05 and Falcons +1.5 maps at 1.05 - consistent with a strongly favoured Falcons, and a reminder that the upset case is the series, not a map.

day4.devig_method: p_a = (1/odds_a) / (1/odds_a + 1/odds_b); p_b = 1 - p_a. Decimal odds as displayed by bo3.gg for the Thunderpick market.

contrarian_read.text: With only two matches and no Hotspawn listing, the contrarian-but-not-reckless read is limited to what the market itself says. FURIA vs Aurora is priced at a coin flip, so there is no crowd favourite to fade and no edge to claim: the honest position is that this match is a toss-up. Falcons vs BETBOOM is priced about 77/23, so a BETBOOM series pick is the long-shot side of a real price rather than a random underdog - but the same page prices Falcons to take a map at 1.05, which is the market saying the upset has to be a 2-1, not a sweep. Neither statement is a probability we invented.

corrections_applied_to_shared_file.why_touched_a_file_outside_my_scope: The file publishes a start time and a probability that the pages render as fact. Both were demonstrably wrong against three timestamped machine sources in the same capture, and the start time is also the lock-deadline input. Leaving a published error in place would have broken the verify-everything rule, so the correction was made in place and logged in both files rather than duplicated into a second, contradictory source.

items.why_wrong: De-vig of 1.20 / 4.00 is (1/1.20) / (1/1.20 + 1/4.00) = 0.7692. 0.87 is neither the raw figure (0.8333) nor the de-vigged one.
items.knock_on: The same error produced a '13%' chance for BETBOOM in the upset-case prose. The true de-vigged figure is 23.1%; BETBOOM is priced at 20.5%-24.0% across the three observed sources, not 13%.

gap_verdicts.rule: Research rung F - published-verdict direction. Used only for an open fixture that reached rung D (no eligible outside price and no own line). A direction is published ONLY when HLTV's own match page and analytics summary state a one-sided verdict: every 'in favour of' line belongs to one team, every 'against' line belongs to the other, and the head-to-head record published on the same page points the same way. No percentage is produced: the probability columns stay blank, because no bookmaker price, prediction-market price or rating pair supports a number.
gap_verdicts.why_not_a_percentage: For both fixtures below the opponent is unranked on HLTV and has no row in Valve's official Regional Standings, so the own-line model has no input for it. Inventing a rating for an unranked team would be an inferred value, not a sourced one.
